name: io.github.your-carstrikeAU/carstrike-mcp-server
description: Live JDM auction search, SEV compliance checks, and import cost calculator.

tools.name: check_sev_eligibility
tools.description: Check whether a specific Japanese vehicle make and model is approved on the Australian SEVs register.

tools.name: search_upcoming_auctions
tools.description: Search live upcoming Japanese auction listings across USS, HAA, and independent Tokyo/Nagoya auctions.

tools.name: calculate_landed_cost
tools.description: Calculate estimated Australian landed costs in AUD from Japanese auction hammer price (JPY).

tools.name: check_physical_inventory
tools.description: Check currently available on-hand or in-transit stock in the CarStrike Brisbane inventory.

tools.name: get_auction_benchmarks
tools.description: Fetch historical Japanese auction price benchmarks and typical sale ranges.
